review_notes.evidence: All seven external inputs independently traced. Upper AG output feeds AK at c115/r19 then descends to r26 and fanout c160. Middle gate input r54 feeds AL.D13 by c115 up to r47 plus c137 rail. Bottom roller input directly drives four N portions with no resistor. All observed diamonds and standalone destination corners preserved. AR prints SPARE without a +/- sign.

AA card first digit is 2-like with lost strokes; �358A5 retained, candidate 3358A5 from A1 and companion card. AR function has only a tiny surviving stroke; � retained, candidate N. AZ first hanging destination lost K; �T561 retained, candidate KT561. Native enlarged crops supplied.

Eight borders fit x=245.084152+40.17610767*c+0.00197693*r; y=282.311087+0.06692871*c+59.86061058*r, max residual 8.84 x/3.76 y pixels. Native vertical projection measures upper channel c160 (160.07), middle c137 (136.94), lower c137 (136.87). Native input strokes independently confirm rows17/21/24/26/28/54/68. No bank shift applied.
